spans.s: मथ् (I) vt. 1P (pres. मथति) To churn.
मथ् (II) vt. or vi. 1P (pres. मंथति) 1. To kill, to injure; 2. to be troubled, to suffer pain, to be afflicted.
मथ m. The same as माथ q.v.
माथ n. 1. Stirring, churning; 2. killing, destruction; 3. a way, a road.
मथन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Stirring round, churning; 2. hurting, injuring; 3. killing, destroying, सखि हे केशिमथनमुदारं रमय मया सह Git.G.ii.
मथन (II) m. Name of a tree.
मथन (III) n. 1. Stirring round, churning; 2. rubbing, friction; 3. injury, destruction.
मथन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Stirring round, churning; 2. hurting, injuring; 3. killing, destroying, सखि हे केशिमथनमुदारं रमय मया सह Git.G.ii.
मथन-अचल m. an epithet of the mount Mandara.
मथि m. A churning-stick.
मथित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Churned, agitated, stirred round; 2. oppressed, afflicted; 3. crushed, pinched; 4. destroyed, killed; 5. dislocated, (pp. of मंथ् q.v.).
मथित (II) m. Pure buttermilk.
मथित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Churned, agitated, stirred round; 2. oppressed, afflicted; 3. crushed, pinched; 4. destroyed, killed; 5. dislocated, (pp. of मंथ् q.v.).
मथिन् m. (Nom. sing. मंथा; acc. pl. मथः) 1. A churning-stick, असंशयं सागरभागुदस्तात् पृथ्वीधरादेव मथः पुराऽयम् Na.xxii.44; 2. the penis; 3. a wind; 4. a thunderbolt.

मथु(थू)रा f. Name of an ancient city situated on the right bank of the Yamunā; it is one of the seven sacred cities and is celebrated as being the birth-place of Kṛṣṇa; it is said to have been founded by Śatrughna, निर्ममे निर्ममोऽर्थेषु मथुरां मधुराकृतिः R.xv.28, कलिंदकन्या मथुरां गतापि गंगोर्मिसंसक्तजलेव भाति R.vi.48.
